test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the FALSE statement.

options.text: The sunflower is a phototrophic plant.
Geotropism is demonstrated by the downward migration of roots.
Hydrotropism is the tendency to grow in moist areas, i.e., the movement of roots towards high humidity.
The growth of pollen tubes towards ovules is an example of geotropism

solution:
The false statement is __**The growth of pollen tubes towards ovules is an example of geotropism**__.
